name: order-placement-duplicate
problem: Duplicate entry when placing an order that already exists
expected_root_cause: Use Eloquent create() for order placement
notes: The previous implementation guarded the insert with an exists() check. The refactor switched to Order::create(), which throws a duplicate-entry SQLSTATE when the order was already persisted on a retry. Laravel frames carry the deploy-root path (/var/www/html), so the repo mirrors that layout.
